Description (Action + Function + Operati: Verify Registration with Valid Credentials (SRS Baseline)
Pre-conditions & Test Steps: Pre-condition: SUT sẵn sàng, CSDL reset seed data. Test Data: Name='Nguyen Van A', Email='validuser@gmail.com', PW='ValidPass@123', Confirm='ValidPass@123'. Steps: 1. Mở /register. 2. Nhập form theo Test Data. 3. Bấm Đăng ký.
